newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-Spencer cleared to play.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Spencer cleared to play.

text.p: DUNEDIN, Aug 15 - All Black first five-eighth Carlos Spencer has been cleared to play in Saturday's trans-Tasman rugby test at Carisbrook after suffering a minor hamstring injury at training yesterday.
All Black reserves for the match (not previously named): Andrew Mehrtens, Ofisa Tonu'u, Scott McLeod, Mark Allen, Anton Oliver, Mark Carter.
